einzeiler: The turbulent life and multi-state crimes of teenage fugitive Colton Harris-Moore
kurzfassung: Colton Harris-Moore grew up in a profoundly abusive and neglectful environment, which fueled a trajectory of escalating criminal behavior from a very young age. Over several years, he evaded authorities by hiding in the wilderness, eventually expanding his crimes to stealing cars, boats, and multiple small airplanes. Following an international manhunt that ended in the Bahamas, he was captured, convicted, and ultimately sentenced to prison before later working to rebuild his life.
stichpunkte: Born in Washington state in 1991, Colton Harris-Moore endured severe neglect and abuse from his mother and absent father.
By age 12, he had accumulated multiple criminal charges and began living off the grid in the woods to escape his home life.
His criminal activities escalated from local burglaries and stolen credit cards to evading police for months using survival skills.
After multiple arrests and escapes from juvenile facilities, he transitioned from stealing cars and boats to teaching himself how to fly airplanes.
He stole and crash-landed multiple aircraft across the Pacific Northwest and beyond, earning notoriety and a massive online following.
His multi-year crime spree finally concluded in July 2010 when he was captured by authorities in the Bahamas.
He pleaded guilty to numerous federal and state charges, resulting in a prison sentence of over seven years.
Following his release and partial restitution payments funded by selling his life story rights, he has focused on moving past his criminal history.

clips.hook: A young delinquent tells authorities he is powerless to stop his own crimes
clips.text: Caught stealing inside a middle school, the young suspect admitted to the principal that he felt completely unable to halt his unlawful actions despite wanting to.

clips.hook: Law enforcement brings in the suspect's mother to coax him out of hiding
clips.text: Officers ultimately broke a lengthy standoff in an empty vacation home by enlisting the suspect's mother to persuade him to surrender.

clips.hook: A fugitive teenager transforms into an unexpected pop culture folk hero
clips.text: As news coverage spread nationwide, the elusive young criminal unexpectedly captured public fascination and inspired merchandise sales.

clips.hook: The multi-state crime spree ends with deportation and federal indictment
clips.text: Following his apprehension abroad, the notorious fugitive was flown back to the United States and faced a lengthy list of serious federal charges.

beschreibung:
When Colton Harris-Moore was ten years old, a series of unfortunate events turned his world upside-down. Within a few months, his behavior worsened significantly, he became destructive and defiant, and he began what would be a considerable criminal career that would eventually reach epic proportions.
Colton’s first arrest came at twelve years old, after he was picked up by police for breaking into homes and stealing property. Another arrest soon followed and by the time he was fifteen, Colton was on the run from police, who wanted him in connection with several robberies on Camano Island, a small island community in Puget Sound. After six months on the run, Colton was arrested and taken to a juvenile facility, but he escaped two months later and embarked on a crime spree, stealing everything from cameras and credit cards to cars and airplanes. Although he would be captured a little over two years later, by the time he was, Colton Harris-Moore had become notorious, with some going so far as to label him a folk hero.
